cohort: 39 women undergoing planned cesarean with desired sterilization using a bipolar electrocautery device, compared to a historical cohort of 40 women who underwent BTL and 40 women who underwent suture-cut-tie salpingectomy
finding: The use of a bipolar electrocautery device for salpingectomy at cesarean delivery resulted in shorter operative times, higher completion rates, and greater surgeon satisfaction compared to standard suture ligation and BTL.
